```sql
WITH kalemler AS (
    SELECT sk.siparis_id,
           sk.urun_id,
           sk.adet AS satilan,
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.adet) FROM iadeler i
                     WHERE i.siparis_id = sk.siparis_id
                       AND i.urun_id    = sk.urun_id), 0) AS iade
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
),
netler AS (
    SELECT sk.urun_id,
           u.ad AS urun_adi,
           SUM(k.satilan - k.iade) AS net_adet,
           SUM((k.satilan - k.iade) * sk.birim_fiyat) AS net_ciro
    FROM kalemler k
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = k.siparis_id AND sk.urun_id = k.urun_id
    JOIN urunler u ON u.id = k.urun_id
    GROUP BY k.urun_id, u.ad
)
SELECT urun_adi, net_adet, ROUND(net_ciro, 2) AS net_ciro
FROM netler
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

| Ürün | Net Adet | Net Ciro |
|---|---|---|
| Laptop | 32 | 980800.00 |
| Kulaklık | 58 | 103770.00 |
| Klavye | 37 | 43200.00 |
| Dambıl | 51 | 38775.00 |
| Tava | 40 | 36855.00 |
